jobs.occupation: Industrial Painter / Surface Treatment Technician - Offshore - Norway
jobs.description: Job description: Industrial painting, surface preparation and protective coating work on offshore oil and gas installations in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea. Typical work includes abrasive blasting, water jetting, coating application by airless spray / brush / roller, stripe coating, and application or repair of epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), including Chartek systems. Work is performed in accordance with project specifications, coating procedures, HSE requirements and client quality standards.Requirements: - Minimum 2 years of relevant, documented experience in industrial painting and surface treatment.- Hands-on experience with surface preparation, including abrasive blasting and/or high-pressure water jetting, and application of protective coating systems.- Documented experience with epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), preferably Chartek or equivalent systems.- Experience with NORSOK M-501 or equivalent offshore coating requirements is an advantage.- Trade certificate (fagbrev) in industrial painting/surface treatment is an advantage. Candidates without a trade certificate must meet §13 or equivalent site-test competence requirements, where applicable.- Minimum B1 level in a Scandinavian language: Norwegian, Swedish or Danish.- Before offshore mobilisation, candidates must meet the assignment-specific requirements for recognised basic safety/emergency training and a valid offshore medical certificate. Exact certificate requirements will be confirmed during recruitment.- Strong HSE awareness, quality focus, reliability and ability to work effectively in multicultural project teams.Type of work contract: Permanent employment with JJS ProsjektPartner AS, subject to the applicable probationary period. Offshore assignments are normally organised on a 2 weeks on / 4 weeks off rotation, subject to client and project requirements.Starting date: Expected start: 01.01.2027. Exact mobilisation date to be agreed with the selected candidate.Working hours: Typical 2/4 offshore rotation: 14 days on / 28 days off, normally 12-hour shifts (168 working hours per 6-week rotation cycle), subject to the assignment schedule.Place of work: Offshore installations in the Norwegian sector of the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS), depending on assignment.Salary: Salary and applicable supplements in accordance with the relevant Norwegian collective agreement (tariff) and assignment-specific terms.Other information: ProsjektPartner coordinates assignment-related travel and accommodation. Selected candidates will receive guidance on mobilisation, required documentation and client-specific courses. ProsjektPartner can assist with selected training through companies in NSE Gruppen.About the company: JJS ProsjektPartner AS is a Norwegian staffing company specialising in qualified personnel for complex industrial projects, both onshore and offshore. With roots dating back to 2003 and as part of NSE Gruppen, we provide experienced professionals within industrial painting and surface treatment, insulation and cladding, scaffolding, and mechanical trades. Our focus is to supply the right competence at the right time, with high standards for HSE, quality and reliable project execution.How to apply? Send your CV and relevant trade/certificate documentation to marco@propartner.no. Please include a short summary of your surface-treatment, offshore and PFP/Chartek experience. You may also call +47 975 92 360.Contact: Marco Scharin+47 975 92 360marco@propartner.noMarco speaks both Finnish, Norwegian and English, and Finnish-speaking candidates are welcome to contact him directly in Finnish.

Qualifications:

• 

Experience from cleaning, property management, hospitality, or similar operational work is an advantage

Structured, reliable, and comfortable taking responsibility

• 

Hands-on and solution-oriented, with an eye for quality and detail

Comfortable coordinating people, schedules, and day-to-day operations

• 

Comfortable using digital tools and documentation

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager (Oslo)
jobs.description:
BrightAnalytics is an ambitious, international scale-up that helps companies make their financial insights faster, better, and more visual. Our headquarters are located in Roeselare (Belgium), but with our five international sales hubs in Rotterdam, Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen and Paris, our ambition is to become the European market leader.

Are you an entrepreneurial Sales Manager and would you like to play a key role and lead our growth in Norway? Ready to help shape our story within the fintech world?

What are your responsibilities as a Sales Manager?
People development

• 
Ensure that our global processes and best practices are being adopted in an efficient way

• 
You are a supportive lead who coaches team members, accelerating their ramp up through focused guidance in cooperation with our Business Development coach and Nordics Sales Manager

• 
Use our sales performance reporting and work side by side with our Nordics Sales Manager and your sales colleagues to spot performance gaps and turn them into growth opportunities

• 
Drive team and individual performance by actively monitoring and refining progress against established KPIs.

Team retention

• 
Motivate and inspire the Norway team to achieve and surpass their goals and reach an overall high level of performance

• 
You support team engagement and contribute to a positive office culture

• 
Lead and support employee conversations in line with the company strategy

• 
Handle specific HR tasks, from time-off requests to day-to-day employee support in cooperation with HR team

• 
You eliminate "micro-friction" in the workspace, ensuring that — form the office environment to administrative workflows—are seamless so the team can maintain 100% focus

• 
You’re the go-to person for team events, creating memorable moments for the whole team to enjoy

Sales Operations

• 
Contribute to the improvement of the overall business by suggesting improved ways of working (workflow, sales tools, Hubspot usage, etc.)

• 
Cooperation with marketing in organizing lead generating activities & sales campaigns

• 
Preparation, coordination, aftercare in the field of events, sales/marketing campaigns (events, webinars, trade fairs…)

Talent acquisition

• 
First selection of candidates for internal roles is managed by our HQ team, you’ll take the lead on final steps to ensure your new colleague is completely aligned with our culture

What is your added value to the sales team?
• 
You hold a Master’s Degree in business and/or economics

• 
You have a successful track record of 5+ years in a business/sales context or experience in a financial position with the desire to make the switch to an entrepreneurial sales/business challenge

• 
Fluency in Norwegian is essential due to the platform’s complexity, and fluency in English is a must in our international environment

• 
Being familiar with the local (business) culture is an asset

• 
You have the ability to inspire people and let them be the best version of themselves

• 
You prefer to work @ the office to support your colleagues in their daily tasks and challenges

The benefits of joining this fintech scale-up
• 
We are a financially healthy scale-up with international growth ambitions

• 
We have an open corporate culture with freedom to take initiative

• 
You will be a pioneer and can make an impact!

• 
With internal trainings and on-the-job coaching, we teach you unique skills that you can use in your further career

• 
A healthy work-life balance is also important to us

• 
Competitive salary with reachable bonuses

• 
25 vacation days + 5 extra = 30 vacation days

• 
Pension plan

• 
You are part of a driven, dynamic and enthusiastic team, you can count on a job full of variety

• 
Friday after-work drinks, legendary team-buildings, and an annual weekend with the entire BrightAnalytics team

Ready to join one of the fastest growing and sustainable Belgian/European fintech companies? Apply today and launch your next career chapter!

Om arbeidsgiveren:
Are you interested in finance & data and looking for more than "just a job" ? Do you want to work in a motivated team with international colleagues where every day brings new opportunities to learn? 

At BrightAnalytics, we understand your ambitions. Our management reporting platform helps CFOs and CEOs to make smarter, faster strategic decisions using implemented Artificial Intelligence. We turn financial, operational data into clear, real-time dashboards, enabling action and delivering impactful results. 

BrightAnalytics counts 130+ young enthusiasts with an academic background in finance working from our headquarters in Roeselare and our offices in Stockholm, Rotterdam, Oslo, Copenhagen and Paris. BrightAnalytics is the place where you can make a lasting impact and
shape your future.

jobs.occupation: Join our Account Executive teams!
jobs.description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

• 
Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

• 
Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

• 
Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

• 
Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

• 
Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

• 
Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer, Radio & Network Systems
jobs.description:
At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you'll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you'll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.
About The Role
Our drones operate as a swarm. They need to talk to each other, and to the ground, in conditions that don't forgive sloppy communications: packet loss, moving nodes, limited bandwidth, and a mix of wireless devices. This role deals with how the network is actually used by applications. You'll work on how data actually moves between nodes in the swarm and between the swarm and ground. The mission is to take communication from working in the lab to working in the field, every time, under contested conditions. That's an architecture problem, a code problem, and a debugging problem in equal measure, and you'll be a key contributor on all three alongside the rest of the team.

You'll work closely with engineers across teams, particularly those integrating new hardware like radios and those running simulation efforts. 
What You Will Do
• 
Drive the architecture call on how messages flow across, whether that's through existing mesh routing protocols or a custom propagation approach

• 
Build robust node-to-node and swarm-to-ground communication

• 
Consider QoS, prioritisation, and fallback behaviour across multiple links, especially under packet loss and mobility

• 
Write the C++ that makes it work, close to the Linux networking stack on embedded systems

• 
Expect a bit of time in the field. Conditions outside the lab surface things a desk never will, and you'll be part of working through them

• 
Be a strong voice on platform and radio decisions where the comms architecture is affected, even though new radio integrations are not your day-to-day
What We Are Looking For
We believe you've shipped real systems over real radio links before, and you know what holds up versus what looks fine in a demo. You might have made the call between mesh and message-flow approaches, or something equivalent, and you can explain why you went the way you did.

We believe the right candidate brings:

• 
5+ years as a software engineer, with 3+ of those building communication or distributed-systems software in production, where lossy links and mobility were real constraints

• 
Strong engineering defaults, comfortable C++ and on embedded Linux

• 
Hands-on experience with mesh or message-flow protocols

• 
Familiarity with IP radios and how application logic sits on top of them

• 
Strong communication skills. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to people who don't share your domain expertise

• 
Fluent in English (Norwegian not required)

• 
A Master's degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field

Nice to have:

• 
ROS 2 / DDS with real QoS tuning experience

• 
MAVLink

• 
4G/5G modems on embedded targets

• 
Background from defence tech, robotics, telco/MANET, or military signals environments
Why You Should Join
At Six Robotics, we're not just building software, we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

• 
Work on problems that matter

Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

• 
Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space

We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

• 
Build from zero, shape the future

Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

• 
Work with purpose, supported by great benefitsYou'll be part of a mission-driven team that values clarity, integrity, and collaboration, offering competitive pay, equity potential, strong insurance and pension plans, and ongoing learning opportunities.Our Recruitment Process

• 
Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min)

• 
Meet & Greet with someone from the team to learn more about us (60 min)

• 
Technical home assignment, ability and personality tests, and a technical interview focused on the specifics of the role (90 min)

• 
Final interview with the engineering lead and Head of People (45 min)Our Commitment to InclusionAt Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.Security Clearance RequirementAll employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. While prior clearance is not necessary, the clearance process will be initiated as part of onboarding.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations.

We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.
